newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain deficit to end 1997 some 40 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Spain deficit to end 1997 some 40 pct lower.

text.p: Budget Secretary Jose Folgado said on Tuesday that Spain's budget deficit on a cash basis would narrow sharply from July, and by the year-end would be down 40 percent.
"Starting from July the deficit will be lower, between 20 and 30 percent over the year-ago period. In fact, at the end of the year, the fall will be close to 40 percent," Folgado said.
In the first five months of the year, on an accumulated cash basis, the deficit was down 10.9 percent at 967 billion pesetas, Folgado said.
He again ruled out the need for a mini-budget and said Spain would meet its target for a central government deficit of 2.5 percent of GDP in 1997.
